analysis: The code snippet has a loop that iterates from i=0 to i < text.length(). The charAt method is called with index i. Since i is always between 0 and text.length()-1 (due to the loop condition), the condition for IndexOutOfBoundsException (negative index or index >= length) is never met. Therefore, the exception is fully avoided.
remark: No exceptions from the charAt method can be thrown in this context because the loop ensures i is always within the valid index range [0, text.length()-1]. The index starts at 0 and increments only while it is less than text.length(), so it never becomes negative or exceeds the string length.
